title: Initialize Hugo terminalcv landing page for jacksovern.xyz
body:
Bootstraps a Hugo static site using `hugo-theme-terminalcv` as a sysadmin-flavored terminal CV landing page for `jacksovern.xyz`, with a custom `services` command surfacing all self-hosted subdomains.

## Changes

- **Hugo site scaffolding** — initialized site structure; `hugo.toml` replaced with `config.yml` to match theme convention
- **Theme** — `hugo-theme-terminalcv` added as a git submodule at `themes/terminalcv`
- **`config.yml`** — fully customized:
  - `baseURL: https://jacksovern.xyz`, green sysadmin-style prompt (`[jack@jacksovern.xyz]:~$ `)
  - Boot sequence mimics a homelab server startup, including service health checks
  - `whois` / `skills` / `projects` sections populated with homelab-relevant content
  - Custom `services` command (via `misc.commandName`) listing all four self-hosted services:
    - `books.jacksovern.xyz` — Audiobookshelf
    - `files.jacksovern.xyz` — Copyparty
    - `torrent.jacksovern.xyz` — qBittorrent
    - `wiki.jacksovern.xyz` — Kiwix
- **`.gitignore`** — excludes `public/`, `resources/_gen/`, and `.hugo_build.lock`

<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> mkdir -p myterminalcv/themes
> cd myterminalcv
> git clone https://github.com/coolapso/hugo-theme-terminalcv themes/terminalcv
> cp themes/terminalcv/exampleSite/config.yml .
> hugo server
> 
> customized to be a fun & nerdy sysadmin site that contains links to my selfhosted sites - 
> 
> The base url for the site is jacksovern.xyz
> 
> Some selfhosted sites include:
> books.jacksovern.xyz - my audiobook platform
> files.jacksovern.xyz - my copyparty instance
> torrent.jacksovern.xyz - my qbittorrent instance
> wiki.jacksovern.xyz - my kiwix instance hosting several wikis (including wikipedia)
> 


</details>
